hero.lead: Callaz runs the calls your team does not have time to make. Appointment setting, outbound sales, customer service and lead generation for Danish businesses, delivered by a named team in Kolding.
assurances: Named team, not a rotating pool

panel.label: Service commitments
panel.note: These are the operating targets a Callaz campaign is run against and reported on weekly. They are commitments, not averages from past campaigns.

solutions.title: Four services. One way of working.
solutions.lead: Every campaign runs on the same method: agreed criteria, a named team, recorded calls and a weekly report. What changes is the job the calls are doing.

cards.appointmentSetting: We book meetings that meet criteria you set in writing, straight into the calendar of the person who will run them.
cards.outboundSales: A trained team sells on your behalf, from your script and your pricing, with the same compliance rules your own staff work under.
cards.customerService: Inbound calls, follow-ups and overflow, answered in the customer language, without adding headcount to your payroll.
cards.leadGeneration: Lists built and cleaned, contacts verified, first touch made. Your pipeline starts with people who exist and answer.

method.title: Four phases, and you see the numbers in all of them
method.lead: Outbound goes wrong quietly. The fix is not a better script, it is a short feedback loop, so the reporting starts in week one rather than at the end of the quarter.

steps.title: Brief
steps.body: We agree the market, the offer, the target customer and the exact criteria a result has to meet before it counts.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Script, objection handling, list and CRM handover are prepared and approved by you before the first call goes out.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.body: A fixed period at agreed volume. You hear real recordings and see what the market actually says back.

steps.title: Scale
steps.body: What worked gets more hours, what did not gets rewritten. Reported weekly, adjusted monthly.

principles.title: The things that decide whether outbound is worth paying for
principles.lead: Anyone can dial. What separates a campaign that pays for itself from one that quietly burns budget is whether you can see inside it while it runs.

recordedCalls.title: Every call is recorded
recordedCalls.body: You can listen to any conversation made in your name, not a curated selection. It is the only way to judge quality honestly, and it keeps us accountable for how your brand sounds.

namedTeam.title: A named team, not a pool
namedTeam.body: You know who is calling for you and you can talk to them. The same people learn your product instead of reading a script cold every morning.

weeklyReporting.title: Weekly numbers, plainly stated
weeklyReporting.body: Dials, conversations, results and what the market pushed back on. If a campaign is not working, you find out in week two, not in month three.

gdprByDefault.title: GDPR handled properly
gdprByDefault.body: A data processing agreement before the first call, documented consent handling, and data returned or deleted when the campaign ends.

noLockIn.title: Monthly terms
noLockIn.body: Campaigns run on a monthly agreement. If we are not earning the next month, you should be able to stop, and you can.

careers.title: We hire people who can hold a conversation, not read a script
careers.body: Callaz is young and growing. That means real responsibility early, training that is actually given rather than promised, and a floor where the good calls get played out loud.
points: Full training before you take a live call
Base salary plus performance pay, written down
Danish and English spoken on the floor
